dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave spline curvature originating from the dorsal ridge toward the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear contour at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width measurement is approximately 0.75 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex pixel boundary with a uniform curvature radius forming the anterior-dorsal cranial surface.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the melon arc transitions into the linear rostrum contour.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan chromatic saturation and distinct specular highlighting along the dorsal-lateral pixel gradient.
